name: Sankt Augustin (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Sankt Augustin (a red lion on white above a blue and white chequy base).
history: Municipal flag of Sankt Augustin; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Sankt Augustin arms — lion above chequy
